Space operations

Source: R/space_ops.R
space_ops.Rd

Vector helpers used throughout manimR. Points and vectors are length 3 numeric vectors; point sets are n x 3 matrices.

Usage

get_norm(v)

normalize(vect, fall_back = NULL)

cross(v1, v2)

rotation_matrix(angle, axis = OUT, homogeneous = FALSE)

rotation_matrix_transpose(angle, axis)

rotation_matrix_transpose_from_quaternion(quat)

rotation_matrix_from_quaternion(quat)

norm_squared(v)

normalize_along_axis(array, axis)

rotation_about_z(angle)

rotate_vector(vector, angle, axis = OUT)

angle_of_vector(vector)

angle_between_vectors(v1, v2)

z_to_vector(vector)

compass_directions(n = 4, start_vect = RIGHT)

regular_vertices(n, radius = 1, start_angle = NULL)

complex_to_R3(complex_num)

R3_to_complex(point)

midpoint(point1, point2)

line_intersection(line1, line2)

find_intersection(p0s, v0s, p1s, v1s, threshold = 1e-05)

shoelace(x_y)

shoelace_direction(x_y)

cartesian_to_spherical(vec)

spherical_to_cartesian(spherical)

get_winding_number(points)

get_unit_normal(v1, v2, tol = 1e-06)

center_of_mass(points)

complex_func_to_R3_func(complex_func)

cross2d(a, b)

perpendicular_bisector(line, norm_vector = OUT)

thick_diagonal(dim, thickness = 2)

Arguments

v, v1, v2, vector, vect

Numeric vectors. In find_intersection(), v1 is the direction of the second line.

fall_back

Value returned for a zero vector.

angle

Angle in radians.

axis

Rotation axis. In normalize_along_axis(), the dimension to take norms along (1 or 2).

homogeneous

TRUE returns a 4 x 4 homogeneous matrix.

quat

A quaternion c(w, x, y, z).

array

A numeric matrix.

n

Number of directions (compass_directions()) or vertices (regular_vertices()).

start_vect

First direction.

radius

Radius of the circle the vertices lie on.

start_angle

Angle of the first vertex; by default 0 for even n and TAU / 4 for odd n.

complex_num

A complex number.

point

A point.

point1, point2

Points.

line1, line2

Two lines, each a list or 2 x 3 matrix of two points.

p0s, v0s

A point and the direction of the first line of find_intersection(): single vectors, or n x 3 matrices with one line per row (then p1s, v1s are matrices too).

p1s, v1s

A point and the direction of the second line.

threshold

Lower bound for the denominator, guarding against parallel lines.

x_y

Vertices of a polygon, an n x 2 (or n x 3) matrix.

vec

A vector c(x, y, z).

spherical

c(r, theta, phi).

points

Points, an n x 3 matrix (one point per row).

tol

Tolerance below which vectors count as aligned.

complex_func

A function of a complex number returning a complex number.

a, b

Two vectors, or two matrices with one vector per row.

line

The two end points of a segment, as a list or a 2 x 3 matrix.

norm_vector

Vector perpendicular to both the segment and its bisector.

dim

Size of the matrix.

thickness

Number of diagonals on each side counted, the main one included.

Value

See Details for functions whose result is not a plain vector.

Details

rotation_matrix_transpose() is the transpose of rotation_matrix(). rotation_matrix_transpose_from_quaternion() returns a list of the three rows of that transpose for the rotation a quaternion describes, and rotation_matrix_from_quaternion() the rotation matrix itself.

norm_squared() is the squared length of a vector. normalize_along_axis() divides a matrix by the norms taken along axis (1 sums over rows, 2 over columns, so axis = 2 gives every row length 1); zero norms are left alone.

z_to_vector() returns a 3 x 3 rotation matrix taking the z axis to the direction of vector.

regular_vertices() returns list(vertices, start_angle), an n x 3 matrix of regularly spaced vertices on a circle centered at the origin and the angle actually used for the first one.

find_intersection() returns the intersection of the line through p0s with direction v0s and the line through p1s with direction v1s; in 3D, the point of the first line closest to the second. Given matrices it works row by row and returns an n x 3 matrix (upstream returns a list of points).

shoelace() returns the signed area of the polygon computed with the trapezoid rule as upstream does (positive for a clockwise polygon), and shoelace_direction() returns "CW" or "CCW" from its sign.

get_winding_number() returns how many times the closed polygon with vertices points winds counterclockwise around the origin.

get_unit_normal() returns a unit vector normal to v1 and v2. When they are aligned (or one is zero) it returns the unit vector in the plane of the remaining vector and the z axis that is perpendicular to that vector, and DOWN when that vector is itself along the z axis.

center_of_mass() returns the mean of points (a matrix with one point per row, or a list of points).

complex_func_to_R3_func() turns a complex function into a function of a point c(x, y, z), through R3_to_complex() and complex_to_R3().

cross2d() returns the determinant a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1] of the first two components, row by row for matrices.

perpendicular_bisector() returns a 2 x 3 matrix with the end points m + d and m - d of the perpendicular bisector, where m is the midpoint of the segment and d is the cross product of the segment (first point minus second) with norm_vector.

thick_diagonal() returns a dim x dim integer matrix with 1 where abs(i - j) < thickness and 0 elsewhere.
